item.title: TrueMapData: from measured height maps to usable assets
item.description: TrueMapData reads surface captures from TrueMap and GelSight, exposes their heights as NumPy arrays, and provides tools for analysis and graphics export. The same surface representation supports metrology work and assets such as displacement maps or meshes.
